observations: The normal FingerprintBoundPrediction.observe path correctly recomputes the explicit observed projection under the supplied StateFingerprint before residual calculation.

FingerprintBoundResidual remains publicly directly constructible. Its __post_init__ validates only that binding_sha256 is a 64-character string, not lowercase SHA-256 hex, and it does not cryptographically or structurally prove that binding_sha256 is the digest of the FingerprintBoundPrediction whose contract supposedly produced the residual.

A caller can therefore assemble a syntactically accepted FingerprintBoundResidual from otherwise valid basis/observation fingerprints plus a compatible PredictionResidual while supplying an arbitrary 64-character binding identifier. This bypasses the normal binding factory path and weakens receipt provenance even though it does not by itself grant action/effect authority.
The current generation-2 tests exercise the normal factory path and wrong fingerprint type/domain cases but do not directly falsify forged bound-residual construction.
risk: Downstream code that treats FingerprintBoundResidual as a provenance receipt can be handed an object whose residual/fingerprints are individually valid but whose claimed binding identity was never demonstrated. Exact causal identity then becomes caller-asserted instead of fail-closed.
hypothesis: Generation 2 should make a bound residual self-authenticating at its declared scope: direct construction with malformed or unrelated binding identity must fail closed, or direct construction must be made non-authoritative and downstream verification must recompute the binding from carried immutable contract/binding material.
counterhypothesis: If FingerprintBoundResidual is explicitly documented as an in-process convenience value and no downstream boundary may trust a directly constructed instance without an external verifier, the current constructor may be acceptable. That weaker interpretation conflicts with using its binding_sha256 as receipt provenance unless the verifier boundary is explicit and tested.
cheapest_discriminator: Regression: build two FingerprintBoundPrediction values over the same basis/observation fingerprints but different prediction/target/expected contract identity; obtain a legitimate residual from A; prove that directly constructing FingerprintBoundResidual with A's residual/fingerprints and B's binding digest (and separately a non-hex 64-character digest) is rejected. No provider, VPS or effect execution is required.
proposed_state_change: NO_CANONICAL_MUTATION_FROM_REVIEW_WORKER. Existing F2-WP-202 G2 mutation owner should consume or falsify this review before reconciliation.
next_exact_action: Active F2-WP-202 G2 owner should add direct-construction provenance regressions; bind the receipt to verifiable immutable FingerprintBoundPrediction identity or explicitly remove direct-construction receipt authority; then run the complete deterministic suite in repository-hosted CI before component-scope reconciliation.
